notes.title: Murder Hour
notes.content:
Every [u]Friday at 5:00 PM to 6:00 PM Event Bosses[/u] will begin spawning in [b]Nova Lux, North Hammerine Wood, South Hammerine, and Parness[/b]. 

Each of these bosses, like our previous Murder Hour Events, are carrying special gear that can be reinforced up to +40. For example, check out Lord 300, below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8062376/499c6a6d97e417416be31f7d5e1429887c09bb94.jpg[/img]

Some of these bosses are easy to find while others are hidden, but the important thing is getting your best group together and having fun. Keep in mind that these are not the normal bosses [i](although a few might pop up here and there[/i]), but Special Event Bosses, so make sure you are ready.

The landscape of Ethergia is once again changed, as mischievous creatures escape from the netherworld and wreak havoc. These dangerous little hell spawns have broken free and are running amok, but not without some little treats up their sleeves.

notes.content:
Hello, 

On February 24,2020 - February 26th, 2020 the Warpportal team will be moving our system servers to a new location which is a process that will unfortunately cause all Warpportal Games and Services (websites, support systems) to be offline.

notes.title: Important Notice Regarding European Region Access
notes.content:
[b]Dear Players,


Due to the changes of our company's service policy for the European regions, we are sadden to bring you news that, all games and WarpPortal services to the European regions listed below will be terminated on May 25th, 2018.


The following European countries will be affected by the termination of service: All the European countries except for Russian Federation and the CIS countries.

notes.title: The Catacombs
notes.content:
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/The-Catacombs.png[/img]

Can you hear their screaming? The agonizing wails of things buried beneath Crescent. In the depths of Nach's eye, they experimented. In the pitch they found something...they were not prepared for.

The Catacombs have opened and the fabric of reality has been thrown open.

Find the [b]Temperion in Nightmare Crescent[/b] who has ignored the summons to the forsaken lands and begin your quest to explore the new dungeons, [b]The Catacombs[/b]. 

Explore the underground and beyond with new creatures not yet seen before.

[b]The Catacombs and The Black Tower[/b]
[I]Nach Trans-Plane Projection[/I]
A means of transit between our dimension and the other.  A Nach Eye has been recently discovered in the Catacombs beneath Crescent.
[b]A Nach Eye has been discovered under the Black Tower in Parness.[/b]
[b]Another, Nach Eye has been known to Ioxenic in the tower at the base of Metulla Mountain on Numaren[/b]
[u]The Nach Eye was already known in North Hammerine.[/u]
[u]The Nach Eye was already known in South Hammerine.[/u]

[b]Investigation of the Transit Phenomenon[/b]
[I]Evidence of a Nach Eye has been discovered in the Catacombs under Crescent [/I]
[b]Professor Helium is recruiting Temperions to investigate:[/b]
Sending them to Nova Lux for instruction where he covertly explains current events and reveals that the entrances to the newly discovered Catacombs are deep in the mines of Crescent.

Accessing the Catacombs via the mine shaft we found a seemingly haunted petrified tree. The tree has been to the dimension the Nach are trapped in and returned. Splinters taken from this tree never reduce its mass but only the spirit at its base may remove any. Other monsters and spirits also seem to emanate or grow stronger near the tree.

[b]Evidence Leads to the Black Tower[/b]

The apparition at the petrified tree reveals the need to investigate further

[b]The portal into the Black Tower has been reactivated by Professor Helium:[/b]
Apparently the tree is the key to the magic to enter the Black Tower portals as it is similar to the Dark Sanctum being a means of transit between dimensions. Whereas accessories from the other side granted access at the Dark Sanctum it is Splinters of the Tree in this case that gain access.

[b]The Battle Between the Worlds:[/b]
It will take time to study the reports of Temperion parties returned from the other side. Professor Helium will publish the findings when complete and perhaps we will know more then about the contents of these new discoveries.

[b]Artifacts of the Past with Memories from the future:[/b]
Temperions have returned with items which Professor Helium revealed may be used to craft new equipment when combined with Ethergian Artifacts. It so happens that the Abandoned and the Fridha mines contain ancient armors not seen in ages. but hoarded by the beasts that now populate the mines.
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/BT_C_1-1024x577.jpg[/img]
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/BT_C_2-1024x578.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Honor System / Alternate Advancement Update Launched
notes.content:
Notes on the Update:

Honor Points will no longer be earned as they were before by specific participation in a Battlefield or a Raid. Instead, Honor serves as an alternate form of Experience that puts more of the character development in your hands. New Builds incorporating the honor skills benefits are sure to arise and compete.

The system is available as before to all character on an account to use but character level restrictions have been introduced and the earned honor grade prerequisite remains to balance out the use of the system.

Keep in mind Honor Experience may be earned playing on a character at level cap or playing a level 1 and up on a reroll. All you have to do is toggle Alternate Advancement ON or OFF from the Character panel (default key: C) using the new button that was teased in early June.If the button has Orange text then Alternate Advancement is OFF and you will earn Character Experience on the character. If the button has Green text then Alternate Advancement is ON and you will earn Honor Experience on the account instead.

[url=http://www.playrequiem.com/notice/84200]Visit our notice page for more details.[/url]

Once a prosperous city-state that rivalled that of Nova Lux, Valdes is now consumed with flames and destruction. notes.title: Patch Notes: Version 175
notes.content:
[h1]General Changes[/h1]

[b]New Dungeon[/b]

"The Gutters"
A new level 15-20 dungeon has been added to the game.
To start the questline to go into the dungeon, talk to the quest giver Maxim located in Turba.

[b]New Dungeon Quests[/b]
New quests and repeatable quests have been added to the following dungeons:

[list]
[*]The Gutters
[*]Ruins of Lament
[*]Ancient Temple
[*]Secret Laboratory
[*]Wrecked Ship of Ru Buran
[*]Jacob's Shrine
[/list]

Quest NPCs are located at the beginning area of each Dungeon.

[b]PvP Rewards[/b]
[Theme Battle] Maximus Compression Xeon and [Theme Battle] Frozen Compression Token success chance has increased from 60% to 100%

[h1]Class Changes[/h1]

[i]Due to various changes to class skills, all classes will have their Skills and DNA reset. We will also provide a free Job Change NPC. This NPC will be located at the Warp Gate in Nova Lux.[/i]

[b]Templar Tree[/b]
Moved Skill: Salvation is now a Templar skill and available at character level 20

Moved Skill: (Resistance) Curse is now a Radiant skill available at character level 50

[b]Rogue Tree[/b]
Removed Skill: Shadow Runner is deleted and no longer a prerequisite to learn Stealth

[b]Shaman Tree[/b]
New Skill: Resurgence Chant  added to Mystic Tree available at level 50
Resurgence Chant: Revive Player

Improved Skill: Mana Burn deals damage to multiple enemies around the target when activated

Improved Skill: Burning Mind heals multiple allies around the caster when activated

Improved Skill: Soul Explosion now has a maximum range of 13 meters (increased from 8) around the caster

Improved Skill: Burning Hell now has a maximum range of 13 meters (increased from 8) around the target

Improved Skill: Fire Fairy’s Protection is now a Shaman skill available at character level 50

[h1]Events[/h1]

[b]St. Patrick's Day Event[/b]

Starts on March 11th and ends on March 18th.


Monsters and creatures all over the world will have a chance to drop different grades of  Pots of Gold. 

Take these pots of gold over to your local Reduction Blacksmith and reduce them to get a chance at some Xeons or Lucky Clover Ornaments.

[b]Double Lant Drop Bonus and +30% EXP[/b]

Starts on March 11th and ends on March 18th.

[b]Compounding Bonus Week[/b]

Starts on March 11th and ends on March 18th.
